contract_answer.question: Can registered one-way prefix drift (lambda*mean|f(x_trunc)-sg[f(x)]|, dropout-free views, rho 0.5) preserve NA-E023's short-prefix gain while reducing held-out drift by at least 50% versus NA-E009 without MAPE above 0.1049, BALANCE_FAIL, or a 76-100 MAPE regression above 0.01?
contract_answer.conclusion: Reviewer recomputation from all 600 selected-checkpoint predictions matches the lead: best epoch 9 of 14, MAPE 0.115705, Acc@15 0.701667, RMSE 25.1718 cycles, bias -19.9436 cycles, and prediction/target spread 0.76887. The parent NA-E009 values are 0.099874, 0.743333, 22.5282, -15.9075, and 0.74972. Prefix-band MAPE is 0.1048/0.0980/0.1105/0.1165/0.1351 versus 0.1221/0.0936/0.0928/0.0932/0.1085. Balance passes (lambda 0.0171808, median R 0.505; cosine +0.750 then -0.967), but held-out drift is 0.0236 versus 0.0264, only 10.5% lower rather than at least 50%, MAPE exceeds 0.1049, and 76-100 MAPE regresses by 0.02664 rather than at most 0.01. The pre-registered rule therefore requires DISCARD.

main_symptom: One-way prefix drift neither retained the two-sided run's short-prefix improvement nor protected the informed long view: overall MAPE rose by 0.0158, 76-100 MAPE rose by 0.0266, negative bias deepened by 4.0 cycles, and held-out drift fell only 10.5%.

causes.class: objective mechanism: stop-gradient full-prefix predictions are biased targets for the truncated view
supporting_evidence: validation_predictions.npz plus experiments/NA-E009/validation_predictions.npz: overall bias -19.94 vs -15.91 cycles
record.json$.metrics.by_prefix: signed relative bias becomes increasingly negative, from +0.0081 at 1-10 to -0.1351 at 76-100
contradicting_evidence: The 1-10 MAPE is still 0.0173 better than NA-E009, so the teacher transfers some useful information at the shortest prefixes
Prediction spread is not collapsed: prediction/target std ratio is 0.7689, close to the parent's 0.7497
causes.interpretation: Detaching the full-prefix branch prevents the symmetric long-view movement diagnosed in NA-E023, but it makes the already under-predicting full view the fixed teacher. Once the auxiliary gradient conflicts with the main loss, shorter views are pulled toward that biased target; all bands after 10 cycles become more negatively biased and less accurate. The registered one-way mechanism therefore cannot meet the accuracy and drift gates at rho 0.5.
missing_evidence: Splits 42 and 2024, which are not justified after the split-2021 rejection rule fired
Saved per-pair full-view and truncated-view predictions during training

causes.class: alternative cause: auxiliary gradient magnitude is too small to halve drift
contradicting_evidence: diagnostics.json$.summary.loss_balance.samples: active fraction is 0.30469 at both checks
MAPE and late-prefix bias already regress strongly, so increasing rho would strengthen the harmful mechanism; lowering rho would weaken an already insufficient drift reduction
causes.interpretation: The auxiliary loss is active and has the intended calibrated gradient magnitude. Its failure is not a balance failure; it is a mismatch between the fixed teacher and the desired correction. A rho 0.25 follow-up has no evidence-led route to both the 50% drift target and the MAPE gate.
missing_evidence: A rho sweep, which is not warranted by the direction's two failed mechanisms

causes.class: evaluation variance: split 2021 contains six validation cells
supporting_evidence: validation_predictions.npz::cell_id contains 6 unique cells and 600 prefix samples
contradicting_evidence: Three independent rejection clauses fail by material margins: MAPE +0.0108 over its limit, drift reduction 10.5% versus 50%, and late-band regression +0.0266 versus +0.01
causes.interpretation: Single-split variance limits broad claims about the objective, but it cannot rescue this exact configuration under its pre-registered split-2021 rule.

next_action.summary: DISCARD NA-E024 under the pre-registered rule and close Phase 2. The frozen parent already gives zero held-out violations and strong correct responses for P0/P0c/P4b; P2 is closed because the parent is voltage-insensitive; two-sided drift reduced drift only 14% and one-way drift only 10.5% while worsening MAPE and negative bias. A rho 0.25 drift run would weaken an already inadequate drift effect, and loss.md 4.1-4.5 offers no evidence-matched correction: the registered asymmetric loss penalizes over-prediction more heavily despite the persistent -16 to -22 cycle under-prediction. The evidence supports the finding that the relevant physics is already encoded by the architecture, then transition to the next authorized phase.
